newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends down in kerb, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends down in kerb, seen stable.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed 0.03 down at 41.95 to the dollar in the kerb market on Thursday amid a rise in demand of the U.S. currency, dealers said.
They said dollar buying might taper off and keep the rupee steady at current levels.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on October 22, was 40.1200/40.3206 to the dollar.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at 4.80 percent compared to Wednesday's close at 4.90 percent.
